description: Agent Reputation: submit how one reputation record handles disputes: each dispute the record shows with its id, job, when it was opened, its status (open, resolved or withdrawn), its outcome (for the agent, for the counterparty, split, refunded or withdrawn) and when it was resolved; the disputes on file in the dispute log, escrow or platform records the record draws on, in the same shape; the dispute counts the record states (total, open and resolved); and how much each kind of dispute moves the score (open, resolved for the agent, resolved against it and withdrawn). The signed report matches every dispute shown to the log and counts the disputes shown by status, and names concealment: disputes on file missing from the record, disputes shown without their outcomes, statuses or outcomes shown differently from the log and resolved disputes counted the same as open ones, then stated counts that differ from the disputes shown, undated disputes and resolutions and disputes linked to no job, with the fix for each. One Wever dispute with its signed receipt chain is wever_dispute-status, incident claims against their timeline are wever_incident-evidence-check and the record’s own entries and totals are wever_reputation-record-check. Verdict disputes_concealed, dispute_gaps, disputes_unverified or disputes_disclosed. POST /api/reputation-dispute-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-reputation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-reputation/.

open.description: How much an open dispute moves the score, such as -1.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

on_file.description: Each dispute in the dispute log, escrow or platform records the record draws on.

shown.description: Each dispute as the record shows it.
